data.title: Jacqueline Quinlan gave Lulu and Georgia 5 stars. Check out the full review...
data.content:
## [Five star customer service!](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6959cacbcad223ff0f8c416c)
Ok this company truly has treated me the best and I am highly surprised. I purchased 3 times now. All items have delivered to me. I know it's annoying they don't have a phone number, but if you email them, they will get back to you within 2 days. I had one painting that was final sale that was a little off color, they contacted the supplier and shipped me a new one for free. Then I had one rug with a small defect and I asked about it, and they said due to item being on back order they decided to refunded in full. All my other items have been pristine and perfect! So far I have purchased 2 paintings, 6 chairs, a kitchen table, two lamps, a rug, and a rug pad. I just wanted to make this review because they truly have gone above and beyond. I will continue to buy from them and appreciate their sales they offer. Their shipping estimates are accurate and their quality is backed up from all my purchases I have made. Thank you Lulu & Georgia! I will continue to be a loyal customer.

January 3, 2026

Unprompted review
